text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- France stresses its solidarity with Iraq's call on warring Kurdish factions to hold peace talks in Baghdad.
- Iraq celebrates the first anniversay of the presidential memorandum of October 15, 1995 which extended President Saddam Hussein's term of office for seven years more.
- National Assembley holds session on Tuesday evening.
- A German MP representing the Green party condemns the embargo.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA.)
(All newspapers carry editorials and articles on the presidential memorandum.)
